utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus, do you have the exact timeline for the repair drive? I like to know when things start and end.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Eli. The drive kicks off at 9 AM with setup, then repairs from 10 to noon, lunch from 12 to 1, and the workshop at 1 PM sharp.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that's exactly what I needed. So the workshop starts at 1 PM—will that cover fixing small appliances like my toaster?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I almost forgot about that. Are you bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm bringing my power drill and socket set to lend out—happy to help fix whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, that's really helpful! I'm still trying to figure out what I have that needs fixing...

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me head to the shed now and confirm the repair drive is there—I'll be right back with an answer.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, Hana, thank you! While you're there, could you also check if we have enough extension cords? I want to make sure we're all set for Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, Pia, I'll check on both the repair drive and the extension cords—I'll have a full update for you in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've got my toolbox ready to go for Saturday—glad to see everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great to hear, Nell! I've been checking in with folks all week, and it's shaping up to be a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: The toolbox is packed, and I heard Rey might bring some spare screws too—things are really coming together!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, the repair drive—I keep meaning to check my schedule. I'll get back to you on it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No rush, Bo! Just let me know if you need help clearing your schedule—I can save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira, that's really kind. I'll try to look at my calendar tonight and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh great, so the drive's definitely on then? I'll bring over that box of screws and my wrench set this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Cleo! That'll be a huge help. I'll let the others know—Rey's bringing tools too, so we'll have a great stash.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, sounds like we're really getting a solid collection together. I'll swing by Faye's place later to drop everything off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Dane! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. Are you planning to bring something in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, sorry I'm late! Yeah, I've got that old lawnmower that's been acting up—think you all can help me get it running again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course we can take a look at it, Dane! Just bring it by Saturday morning, and our volunteers will see what they can do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, a blender and a toaster—sounds like we'll have a good variety of small appliances to work on!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, and I just told Opal that Hana's checking the shed right now to make sure everything's set up for Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the update, Vik. I'll head over to check on Hana and make sure we have enough workbenches set up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the status on getting the tools together? Do we have a full list of broken items yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I've got a couple of old tools that might still have some life in them, but I'm not sure they're worth the trouble.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bring them over and let's see if they're salvageable. If they are, we'll add them to the pile—if not, we'll scrap 'em.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rey, the repair drive is definitely locked in — we're all set for Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to know, Opal — I'll bring my old blender down for the repair folks to look at.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Rey! We'll have a fix-it station for small appliances, so your blender is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, once Hana confirms what's in the shed, we can match up what you're bringing and fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, just let me know what's missing and I'll grab it from my garage.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I'll start a list of what everyone's bringing so we don't end up with ten hammers and no screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Tess, are you sure about this repair drive? I need a solid yes or no — have we got the green light or not?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, it's on for sure! Gus is leading the first stop at the Smiths' fence.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Gus is actually heading it? That's a bit more reassuring, but I still need to hear it from him directly before I start hauling my gear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, glad I caught you—I'm pulling together a repair drive for the community center this Saturday. Any chance you've got spare tools or parts lying around?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Cleo, I've been planning a repair drive myself! I'll bring my full toolkit—got it all sorted already.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's perfect, Gus—thanks! Let's sync up on Saturday morning to make sure we have everything covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm glad you're on board! Let's make sure we get a good turnout for the repair drive next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll bring my power drill and some spare screws. Just tell me where to set up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Leo! I'll let the others know you're bringing your drill—we'll set up a station for you near the picnic tables.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is definitely locked in for Saturday at the community center. I've already got the tool list organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, perfect timing! Let me go over my list of what people are bringing so we can make sure nothing overlaps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got a full inventory of everyone's tool commitments — I can cross-check that list with yours right now to avoid any duplicate efforts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing old appliances for free, and there's even a workshop afterwards!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs to be repaired? I'd rather know ahead of time so I can bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, all sorts of things! Gus is in charge, and he said they'll be fixing toasters, lamps, even small electronics. And the workshop after sounds super handy for learning basic fixes!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, so it's just drop-in for small appliances all day then?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Exactly, Rey! Drop-in all day, but mornings are best for diagnostics. Can I count on you for a bit then?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can swing by in the morning. I've got a few spare cords and maybe some screws to drop off too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Oren, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I almost forgot about that. Are you bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think I've got a broken toaster I've been meaning to bring. It's been sitting on my counter for months.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm glad so many folks are pitching in for Cleo's drive—it'll really help restock that bench.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I still need to fix that squeaky gate. Maybe I can grab some tools for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, you might find just the thing there—folks are bringing all sorts of bits and pieces. What's the gate need?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I keep meaning to sign up but I keep forgetting—did you say it's next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Bo, hold on — is the repair drive actually confirmed for Saturday, or are you asking me like I know more than you do?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm asking you — I saw a flyer but I can't remember the date. Saturday rings a bell?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me head to the shed and double-check on the repair drive—I'll also grab those extension cords while I'm at it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Hana! I'll note that you're handling the extension cords. Want me to grab the toolkit from my garage and meet you there?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, Sam, that sounds good. I'll meet you at the shed in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm helping out with tools—should be a great way to fix things up together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh Jules, perfect timing! I've been rallying folks to bring in their broken items and gather supplies. Do you have any particular tools you're bringing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I've got my power drill and a full socket set ready to go, and I can swing by early to help set up if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I heard about the repair drive from Rosa, but I'm not sure how much help I can be.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, don't worry—every little bit helps. Do you have any particular skill or tool you could bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just some old hand tools, maybe. I'm not much of a fixer, but I can lend a hand where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Vik, yes I heard about the repair drive! But just a heads-up, the date has been moved to Sunday instead of Saturday. Still at the community center, same time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Sunday! Thanks for the update, Rosa—I'll make sure to tell Ira and Jules about the change. I'll still bring my old blender!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Vik! Also, I'm coordinating with Mara for supplies, so let me know if you think of anything else we might need.
